label: a mountain range.
why: A wide dark mountain ridge with a peak on the right stands across the frame above a stony plain under a grey sky, and neither the mountains nor the camera move except for a slight drift. A dissolve from the snowy slope ends near 6.25 s and a dissolve into the globe starts at 10.25 s, so 6.5 to 10 s is one continuous held shot of the mountains.
